name: quezo
description: Quezo prototype architecture and development scaffold

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory postgres --locked uvicorn --app-dir src quezo_api.app:create_app --factory --loop quezo_api.database:database_loop_factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 --no-server-header --reload
scripts.start:api: uv run --directory postgres --locked uvicorn --app-dir src quezo_api.app:create_app --factory --loop quezo_api.database:database_loop_factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 --no-server-header
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --directory postgres --locked alembic upgrade head
scripts.test:db: uv run --directory postgres --locked pytest tests/test_migrations.py tests/test_database.py tests/test_database_isolation.py tests/test_app.py
